title: Winter and Hymn
author: I. M. Halloran
blurb: Quentin Halloran, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the last resident signs the papers.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
